108:         }

263:             combiner_go_to_responding() {
264:                 require(pre.combiner.is_Collecting());
265:                 require(pre.combiner.get_Collecting_elems().len() == pre.num_clients);

276:                 let j = pre.combiner.get_Responding_idx();
